title: The publication rule
summary: States, in four plain rows, what it takes for a readout to appear on this page, and ends on the honest status in the header's own words, replacing the old terminal block (“readouts.index — first client releases pending clearance”) and its blinking cursor.
story: The hinge between the specimen and the ask. Having seen exactly what a readout is, the sceptic learns why no real one is shown: it is the client's, it is published only on the client's written say-so, it can be stripped of names and numbers, and the first one to clear will appear here. The last row lands on “Cleared for publication · None yet”, closing the loop the header opened.
